I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks, Tobias, noted. Expense reports are due Friday (Oct 16) for anyone on the Central team who hasn't filed yet."

He was only posting a reminder, so I didn't look anything up. The Oct 16 date is just the Friday after today (Wednesday, Oct 14). I didn't check it against any expense policy.
